findings.title: Compilation error: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() called with no arguments
findings.body: `UsernameForm.authenticate` calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments, but `UsernamePasswordForm` only defines `protected boolean isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)` taking a `UserModel` parameter. This causes a compilation failure (`method isConditionalPasskeysEnabled in class UsernamePasswordForm cannot be applied to given types`).

findings.title: Passkeys conditional UI is broken for initial login because user != null is required
findings.body: `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)` returns `webauthnAuth != null && webauthnAuth.isPasskeysEnabled() && user != null`. During normal initial login, `context.getUser()` is `null`, so `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser())` at lines 115 and 137 always evaluates to `false`. Consequently, `webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context)` is never called when no user is pre-selected, completely breaking passkey / WebAuthn Conditional UI login on initial login forms and after failed login challenges when the user was not already known.
